In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], a lone [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] representing the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] attempted to '''assassinate''' the [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]]. The first attempt was when Satine was leaving the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] in her speeder that was sabotaged. The second attempt was in the lower levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. While Satine was meeting [[Davu Golec/Legends|her contact]], he was shot and she became the suspect. She was running from Republic [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|authorities]] as well as her assassin. Eventually, Jedi Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] was able to meet up with her to help her.

==The plot==
===First attempt===
[[File:AramisDies-DoM.png|thumb|left|230px|Satine during the first assassination attempt]]
Satine left the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] in her private airspeeder escorted by [[Mandalorian Royal Guard/Legends|her guards]] and pilot [[Aramis/Legends|Aramis]]. Mid-flight, a [[Unidentified Death Watch assassin/Legends|Death Watch assassin]] watching from below set off a detonator attached to the vehicle. Now almost completely out of control, her pilot maneuvered towards a landing platform for Satine to jump onto. She and her guards landed safely, only to see the speeder smash into a building and erupt into a fireball seconds later.

===Second attempt===
[[File:Satine_on_the_run.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Satine running from the Death Watch assassin]]
Satine met secretly with her contact from the [[Republic Ministry of Intelligence/Legends|Republic Ministry of Intelligence]], [[Davu Golec/Legends|Davu Golec]], in the lower levels of Coruscant. He delivered her a disc that contained the original recording of the message [[Deputy Minister/Legends|Deputy Minister]] [[Jerec/Legends|Jerec]] created, not the altered version the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] had seen earlier. A Death Watch assassin who had followed Golec there took aim and [[Death/Legends|shot]] him, but did not manage to kill Satine due to the inadvertent interference of a [[Police probe/Legends|police probe]] that came to respond to the scene. Mistaking her [[Deactivator hold-out pistol/Legends|droid deactivator]] for a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], it erroneously identified Satine as the culprit. A chase ensued, but the Duchess eventually lost the [[Police droid/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone shock trooper/Legends|authorities]].

===Third attempt===
After escaping Republic authorities, Satine contacted and met up with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] for help. On her way to their meeting place, the assassin continued to follow her. Once the target and Jedi were in an alley, the assassin, now on a rooftop, tossed down a [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonator]]. Kenobi noticed the explosive and [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force Push|pushed]] Satine out of its range before he himself dove to safety, all moments before it went off. He jumped down from the rooftop and began to walk slowly towards the Duchess with blaster in hand to finish her off, but Kenobi interfered, drawing the assassin's attention to him. Kenobi was later able to pass through Republic security when Satine turned herself in. Kenobi then presented the message to Satine's new friend, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], who presented the message before the Senate, thus saving Mandalore from a Republic occupation.
